name: 02379 · W Bridgewater, MA
findings: ZIP 02379 (W Bridgewater) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02379 (W Bridgewater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02379 (W Bridgewater) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
